sentences: 10 similar listed companies trade at 55.2x to 81.4x their yearly profit (middle: 60.7x).
Applied to its earnings per share of ₹4.92 in Q1FY27 (₹19.68 for a full year), a share would be worth ₹1,086.88 (low), ₹1,195.17 (middle) or ₹1,601.26 (high).
Against the top of the price band, ₹693, the middle value means 72.5% upside.
Q1FY27 covers only part of a year; scaling it up assumes the rest of the year goes the same way.
Cross-check: at the peers' middle EV/EBITDA of 33.6x, after taking off net debt, a share would be worth ₹1,370.14 against ₹1,195.17 from P/E: the two agree.
This is a rough guide, not a forecast: it assumes the company deserves the same price tag as its listed peers.
